newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power prices for Friday unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power prices for Friday unchanged.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left price offers for Friday pre-scheduled power unchanged, the agency said Thursday.
BPA continued to limit sales of both firm and non-firm power during peak hours to 500 megawatts.

The agency also continued to offer "market expansion" power at $7.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for hours ending 0100-0600 and 2300-2400 PST on Friday, and at $9.00 for hours ending 0700, 1200-1600 and 2200.
Friday firm power during off-peak hours was unchanged at $10.50 per MWh for all deliveries, while peak power was offered at $15.25 in the Northwest and $16.25 at the California-Oregon border (COB).
Prices for Friday non-firm power during off-peak hours were unchanged at $10.50-11.50 per MWh, while on-peak offers remained at $12.75-17.50 in the Northwest and $13.75-18.50 at COB.
